heard: What did you go to the wild to see? A reed shaken by the passing wind Or a man in soft and costly clothes Those who wear such splendor dwell in palaces But what did you go there to find? A prophet, yes, and far more than that Behold, I send my messenger ahead Who will prepare your way before you No one born of women is greater than John Yet the least in the kingdom is greater than he This generation is like children in the...
